change: Connect the bounded source observer, immutable byte-span normalization and memory reader to the dwg2dxf converter. The CLI explicitly opts in; existing dx_iface consumers remain opt-out. Store the original snapshot and immutable alias proof, revalidate the source mapping at strict output preflight, and reuse the staged plot/dictionary/XRECORD inspectors and final handle/owner checks. A sticky required-proof marker refuses export after a failed projected import or failed reimport. Existing whole-source and legacy identity observation opt-ins keep original-stream behavior and do not enable the projection.

validation.focused: PASS compact graph, whole-source capture and AC1024 DWG plot-style tests. ASCII/Binary controls exercise opt-out, source-file changes after import, source/target handle collision, wrong graph references, late mutation, non-strict/cross-version/cross-encoding refusal, preserved destination and corrected same-adapter retry, malformed import then retry, failed reimport with sticky refusal, failure during projected read, same-file rollback and retry, and existing source-observer opt-ins. GCC 16 syntax checks pass with -Werror.
validation.directPeer: The actual current CLI converts the original wide ezdxf-generated AC1027 sources directly in both encodings. Independent ezdxf 1.4.5 compares the original source with each output: 25 mapped objects, 24 dictionary entries, 13 root entries, two layers, dictionary ownership, selected reactors, XRECORD group-340 reference, DICTIONARYVAR values and MATERIAL body; zero audit errors/fixes. The wide numeric handles are mapped to distinct 32-bit output identities.
validation.libredwg: GNU LibreDWG 0.14 dxf2dwg independently reads each output and writes an R2004 scratch DWG; dwgread JSON resolves root handle 12, dictionary 47, XRECORD 48, owner links, text and group-340 reference 47. The converter reports unsupported MATERIAL and MLEADERSTYLE objects, so this establishes the selected dictionary/XRECORD graph only, not complete drawing conversion.
validation.negative: Six malformed-source variants plus cross-version and cross-encoding requests for each encoding (16 CLI cases) refused and preserved the preexisting destination. Whole-source observation requests on the wide inputs also refused with destination preserved. Narrow ASCII/Binary controls still convert.

limits: One locally generated AC1027 source profile with one selected dictionary/XRECORD chain; original wide identities are remapped, not preserved numerically. Unknown or additional wide references and unqualified graph shapes remain refused.
Only strict same-version and same-encoding output is admitted; original-stream observation opt-ins still refuse the source until their provenance can be bound.
The public dxfRW file reader remains 32-bit for typed graph callbacks; only explicitly opted-in dx_iface callers and the CLI use the projection.
Native consumer, independent producer and other platform/version/geometry qualification remain open. No DXF/DWG files were committed.
